summary: Keep published agent rosters and collection views available while a graph-preserving local trim records tombstones and finishes, including the initial bounded roster head. Recording invalidates only the replication inventory; completion releases history-dependent reductions without withdrawing presentation generations. Telemetry fixtures wait on collection publication events rather than another list's readiness or retired checkpoint claims.

replay.detail: No replay changes; replaced projections still invalidate their publications.

rules.detail: Retention rules and graph-equivalence checks are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Local trim completion no longer temporarily withdraws graph-equivalent lists.

manual.detail: No configuration or operator action required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
